sd_prompt_body: numerous discrete skin-colored to slightly erythematous dome-shaped papules, some with small whitish centers, scattered across the skin, giving a bumpy texture to the affected area

large confluent area of deep erosion with a raw, granular surface, exhibiting prominent yellowish-brown crusting and some purulent material. The lesion is erythematous with dusky areas, and has irregular, raised borders. Surrounding skin is erythematous and edematous.

Confluent, irregular patches of thickened, hyperpigmented skin with exaggerated skin markings, consistent with lichenification, affecting the periorbital region. Mild underlying erythema is present, contributing to the overall dusky appearance.

Inflamed, dusky nodules embedded in the skin of the toes, with central dark spots representing the embedded parasite. Significant surrounding hyperkeratosis, crusting, and erosions are present, particularly around the nail folds.
numerous discrete violaceous papules, round to ovoid in shape, slightly raised from the skin surface, scattered across the arm and neck, with well-defined borders.

Widespread confluent erythematous plaques and papules with fine yellowish scale, exhibiting characteristic islands of sparing of normal skin, creating a reticulated pattern, with a rough, slightly raised texture.

Extensive confluent erythematous plaques with irregular borders, showing prominent fine peeling scale and desquamation. The inflamed skin appears bright pink to red, contrasting sharply with surrounding areas of hyperpigmented, sun-damaged skin, creating a mottled appearance.

multiple grouped violaceous flat-topped polygonal papules and plaques, some annular, exhibiting fine white reticulated striae and central hyperkeratosis, with surrounding post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation.

large ovoid erythematous plaque with an irregular border, exhibiting a verrucous surface texture. Numerous small white pustules are scattered across the lesion, with fine hairs growing through the affected area.

Numerous coalescing follicular papules, violaceous to reddish-brown in color, forming thickened plaques with significant fine white scale. The skin appears rough and xerotic, with prominent accentuation of skin lines and some fissuring, particularly on the fingers.

multiple discrete dark brown papules, central lesion with irregular shape and verrucous surface, smaller lesions round, all appearing stuck-on, fine scale present on larger lesion, surrounding skin smooth.

Severely sun-damaged scalp with extensive atrophy and dyspigmentation. Numerous irregular brown and black macules coalesce with hypopigmented white patches. The skin appears wrinkled and scarred, with sparse hair growth, reflecting chronic UV exposure and premature aging.

Extensive, confluent, irregular dark brown and black macules and papules, with areas of thick crusting and erosion. Significant atrophy and scarring, particularly around the eyes and nose. The skin appears severely sun-damaged, xerotic, with diffuse hyperpigmentation and multiple raised lesions.

Multiple grouped, flat-topped, polygonal papules and plaques, violaceous to greyish in color, exhibiting a shiny surface. Fine whitish reticular lines (Wickham's striae) are visible on some lesions, with surrounding post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation.

Multiple erythematous, raised papules and plaques with serpiginous and irregular shapes, showing prominent crusting and erosions on their surface. The lesions are linearly arranged, creating a distinctive pattern of inflammation.

Multiple coalescing nodular masses with variegated dark brown, black, and violaceous pigmentation. Irregular, firm surface with areas of erosion and crusting. Ill-defined borders and surrounding thickened skin.

diffusely swollen and thickened violaceous plaques on lips, with prominent painful erosions and hemorrhagic crusting, subtle white reticular striae visible on the surface, irregular borders and diffuse involvement

Confluent, irregular erythematous plaques with central atrophy and scarring, surrounded by areas of marked hypopigmentation and patchy hyperpigmentation. Fine scale is present on some active erythematous areas, affecting the scalp and ear.
Severely dystrophic nail plate, marked subungual hyperkeratosis, extensive onycholysis, brownish-yellow discoloration, rough and crumbly texture, with surrounding inflamed and scaly periungual skin.

Multiple discrete dome-shaped papules and a larger violaceous nodule, firm and well-defined, with a smooth to slightly irregular surface, appearing on the skin adjacent to the eye, characteristic of sarcoidosis.

A solitary, firm, dome-shaped erythematous nodule with a well-defined border. The lesion exhibits a central ulceration and dark crust, suggesting an invasive process. Surrounding skin shows signs of chronic sun damage.

A large, firm, indurated plaque with an irregular, spreading border, dark brown to black in color, showing a smooth, shiny surface and extending beyond original wound margins, characteristic of a keloid.

An irregular, exophytic, vegetative mass, predominantly erythematous with areas of white exudate and erosion. Visible sutures indicate recent intervention. The lesion has an irregular border and is localized.

Grouped, irregular plaques with violaceous, hyperpigmented borders and thick, yellowish-white crusting scale. Central areas exhibit significant hypopigmentation and atrophy. Rough, verrucous surface texture with prominent follicular plugging.

multiple deep, punched-out ulcers with yellow exudate and purpuric bases, surrounded by erythematous and edematous skin; scattered smaller excoriated papules and nodules, with extensive crusting and signs of severe scratching.

Large, deeply ulcerated, fungating mass with irregular, raised borders. The base shows erythematous granulation tissue, yellowish exudate, and areas of dusky necrosis. Surrounding skin is atrophic and dyspigmented.

Numerous scattered hypopigmented macules and atrophic patches mixed with small, raised, skin-colored to erythematous papules, indicating chronic sun damage and varied lesions, with overall dyspigmentation.

Extensive erythematous, thickened plaques covering palms and fingers, with prominent, adherent white scale. Deep fissures are visible within the thickened skin, giving a rough, dry appearance. The lesions are confluent, creating a widespread, inflamed surface.
